question.text: The set of elements that differ in mutual relationship from those of the other sets is:

solution.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Li</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>Mg</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>Si</mi><mo>,</mo></math> <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Be</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>Al</mi></math> show diagonal relationship but <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Li</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Na</mi></math> do not show diagonal relationship as both belongs to same group and not placed diagonally.
